# Notes

## Working URL pattern (as of today)

All four mirrors require a session prefix. The easiest one to use:

- Get session from `https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/` -> returns prefix like `/s/XXXXXX/`
- Full URL: `https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/XXXXXX/<target url>`
- It renders JSON inline (with a "# ..." header), which is easy to read.

Example that worked:
`https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/ieqh524y/https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json`

## County C-17 (Elm County) median_rent_2021

Note: delta-cache.invalid has a stale 2019 snapshot that reports 1290 for the same county — do not trust it.
